pages.title: Bulk Crystal
pages.text: A translucent crystal from the Bulk whose facets seem to point in directions I cannot quite name. Light passing through comes out a little out of phase with itself, as if it had taken a short detour through another axis.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I found these growing in the Bulk where the extra dimensions are most tightly curled. Looking through one, I saw my own hand from an angle I should not have been able to see it from.

Made in $(item)Graviton Condenser$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Brane Cosmology.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Brane Tension Fiber, Bulk Cache, Graviton Wisp Core, Silicon Life Spore, String Coupling Crystal.
